Hi Sophie,

Thanks again for taking the time — excited to move you into a virtual fullloop for the Software Engineer role. Below is the plan we're proposing for Tue 2 Apr (I'll attach an .ics once we confirm):

- Window: 9:00–13:30 PT (4 slots + 30m buffer)
- Slot A (9:00–9:45 PT): System Design (senior eng)
- Slot B (10:00–10:30 PT): Deep Dive (domain/algorithms)
- Slot C (11:00–11:30 PT): Team Fit / PM cross-collab
- Slot D (12:15–12:45 PT): Exec / culture wrap + Q&A

We prefer the above sequencing (design first) to get sync on approach and give smaller back-to-back slots for the deeper technical dive. Please confirm your availability for that window and whether you need any timezone adjustments (I see you're based in EST).

I've attached the scorecard template we use so interviewers can keep feedback concise. If anything in the plan doesn't work, let me know and we can pivot.

Thanks,
